estimates.assumptions: Custard here refers to ready-made custard (vanilla sauce); standard UK ready-to-eat custard is ~132 kcal/100 g. Supplied measurement is already in grams so used directly.
Digestive biscuits (sweetmeal cookies) average ~480 kcal/100 g; measurement supplied as 200 g so used directly. 'Shredded' describes preparation but does not change edible mass.
Custard powder (e.g. Bird's style) is a dry starch/sugar mix; 1 tbs ≈ 8 g so 3 tbs = 24 g. Typical dry powder density is ~360 kcal/100 g.
